correctness.rationale: PASS. For Q=Z/nZ, a(i)=i+1 and b replacing only state 0 by d, every strict rank-decreasing b in coordinates undone by cumulative rotations removes p and requires p+d still present. Consequently to delete H=Q\S with minimum k=n−|S| b letters, legal orders are exactly the linear extensions of induced forward-d paths; each maximal run of length ℓ_j is internally fixed, and interleavings give k!/∏ℓ_j!. A whole d-orbit in H would form an impossible directed cycle, so reachability occurs iff S meets all g=gcd(n,d) residue classes; converse uses rotations to implement each legal p sequence. For coprime d, run count at most min(k,n−k); factorial log-convexity and splitting show the balanced maximum with r=min(k,n−k), k=qr+t, count k!/(q!^(r−t)(q+1)!^t). Singleton complement is one long d-path, enforcing p_{j+1}=p_j+d and each minimal inter-b rotation a^(n−d), yielding the unique shortest reset word AMONG those with exactly n−1 b letters: b(a^(n−d)b)^(n−2), total length 1+(n−2)(n−d+1). No claim about unrestricted shortest reset words. Independent 0–1 shortest-path subset BFS exhaustively confirmed nonempty targets n=2..7 and all 1<=d<n; primary artifacts/verify.py implements all-target/schedule permutation checks through n=8. Infinite-parameter proof is combinatorial, not finite-sample inference.
